decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app is promoted as a new product line close to the core software, costs little to keep as a modular extension, and its value under the digitalisation trend in dental practices is still unfolding, so the option should stay open.

The continuing education institute builds on existing training content and customer relationships, so it is cheap to keep running while demand from dental professionals is still uncertain, though it sits a bit further from the software core.
The remote screen sharing support tool backs the firm's support operations at low marginal cost and improves service efficiency, so there is no evidence yet that would justify abandoning it.
